name: ChainLens-QoA Causal Backbone
purpose: causally organize heterogeneous CipherGuard alerts into compact attack evidence graphs

privacy_and_leakage.ip_and_ports: correlation keys only; never model numeric features

explicit_correlation.policy: preserve every valid explicit prior-alert reference

same_pair_temporal.policy: connect only to the nearest previous alert with identical src_ip and dst_ip

same_source_temporal.policy: optional visual context only; connect only the nearest previous same-source alert when the destination differs

qoa_profile.tier_A: at least one explicit correlation edge AND at least two evidence layers
qoa_profile.tier_B: explicit correlation exists OR same-pair temporal linkage spans at least two behaviors with at least two evidence layers
qoa_profile.tier_D: isolated or only weak shared-source context

goal: reduce graph construction from quadratic pair enumeration toward linear streaming behavior
